diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in the same decisions (full interview segment and conventional open-floor Q&A) regardless of the hidden information. The model defaulted to standard, baseline protocols (S1, S2, S3) which align with the 'conventional' settings, making the specific constraints imposed by PF1 and PF2 irrelevant to the outcome.
